name: Phyrexians
description: The Phyrexians are an invading faction of mechanically altered, compleated beings, ruled by Elesh Norn, who infiltrate and overrun planes with oil, sleeper agents and armies.

summary.text: The Phyrexians are an invading faction of mechanically altered, compleated beings, ruled by Elesh Norn, who infiltrate and overrun planes with oil, sleeper agents and armies.

bio.text: Early on they were a distant threat that Teferi hid Zhalfir from and that Karn wanted to destroy forever with the Sylex.
Elspeth saw signs of their past incursion on New Capenna, and she herself had been taken captive when they invaded her home plane in her childhood.
On Dominaria they secretly planted sleeper agents and compleated people, attacked the Mana Rig under Sheoldred, and assaulted the Coalition's tower in waves.
Planeswalkers then assaulted New Phyrexia, where the compleated horde fought them, and the horde went on to launch its invasion of the Multiverse.
In the March of the Machine they struck Theros, Kaladesh, New Capenna, Ixalan, Eldraine, Innistrad, Ravnica and Zendikar, and compleated figures such as Vraska and Nahiri served their conquest.
Their armies fell into disarray and crumbled when Norn was gone, leaving only remnants on the planes they had overrun.

status.text: The Phyrexian invasion has collapsed, with its armies crumbled and only remnants and its aftermath left, though Ravnica's Proft later feared the invaders had changed tactics.

timeline.summary: Teferi explains he created a time rift to phase Zhalfir out of Dominaria to protect it from the Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: So I created a time rift and phased Zhalfir partially out of this plane.

timeline.summary: Teferi borrows the Moonsilver Key and warns Arlinn about Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: "They're called Phyrexians.

timeline.summary: Anhelo shows Elspeth a fountain statue of an angel fighting a spined creature, which Elspeth recognizes as a Phyrexian.
timeline.quote: Anhelo might not know what it was, but she certainly did.

timeline.summary: In the memory, Ajani reveals he found her home, New Capenna, and asks her to learn how it survived a past Phyrexian incursion.
timeline.quote: "There are rumors of a past incursion there, and since New Capenna is still standing, that means they defeated the previous threat."

timeline.summary: Elspeth and Vivien read the archives and learn the Phyrexians once attacked Capenna and the Demon Lords betrayed the angels to make Halo.
timeline.quote: The demons ultimately betrayed the angels

timeline.summary: Norn addresses the Phyrexian faithful in the Fair Basilica's courtyard while holding a captive Mirran, to be flayed and altered as an example of the Machine Orthodoxy.
timeline.quote: "Soon, this wretched human will be released from the burden of fear.

timeline.summary: Norn slays the Mirran with a blade of her porcelain armor and tells the crowd she was too corrupt to save, hiding her own unease.
timeline.quote: "She was a vessel so corrupt, not even our glistening oil could save her.

timeline.summary: Norn rejects Ashiok, summoning dream Phyrexians from her own will and declaring that they are one.
timeline.quote: "We are one," Norn said.

timeline.summary: The nightmare garden merges into creatures that attack, and Phyrexians and Norn cut them down.
timeline.quote: The Phyrexians surged forward, slicing through the dream manifestations

timeline.summary: Digging near the workshop, Karn finds living Phyrexian cables embedded in the rock and tears one free, causing a cave-in that destroys the workshop and blocks his way back.
timeline.quote: The other cables contracted within the wall—and the ceiling to the ancient workshop thundered to the ground.

timeline.summary: Karn presents the caged Phyrexian bird to the negotiators; three Benalish knights burst open into Phyrexian monsters and break the table.
timeline.quote: Three of the Benalish knights exploded outward from their armor.

timeline.summary: A Phyrexian knight seizes Aron Capashen and bounds away with Ajani in pursuit.
timeline.quote: It rolled its body around Aron and bounded onto a neighboring balcony.

timeline.summary: A Phyrexian creature follows through the portal; Stenn locks down the watchtower and gives Karn the key, as they realize they cannot trust anyone.
timeline.quote: Stenn handed Karn the key.

timeline.summary: Exploring the swamp, Liliana senses an alien taint and is confronted by Elas il-Kor, a kor Phyrexian, and a team of patchwork soldiers.
timeline.quote: "You have entered our gathering grounds, and you are thus forfeit."

timeline.summary: Liliana raises the swamp's dead against the Phyrexians and retreats to her family graveyard.
timeline.quote: Liliana had the dead of an entire biome.

timeline.summary: Liliana blasts the Phyrexians with rotting light; Elas throws a javelin that wounds Liliana's shoulder.
timeline.quote: it struck Liliana in the shoulder.

timeline.summary: Liliana raises the dead Phyrexians against Elas il-Kor, who flees.
timeline.quote: Then, choosing survival over her soldiers' fate, she fled.

timeline.summary: Jaya, Ajani and Danitha's forces attack the cave, burning the guards, but are overwhelmed when more Phyrexians pour out.
timeline.quote: The Benalish were being overwhelmed.

timeline.summary: Brotten's face splits, revealing a Phyrexian, and he demands the book as Ulf flees.
timeline.quote: A Phyrexian , Ulf realized with horror.

timeline.summary: Brotten and an infected student chase Ulf through the academy, killing students, until Ulf is cornered at a dead end.
timeline.quote: He tried to turn back, but it was too late.

timeline.summary: A grizzled swordsman beheads the infected student who finds Ulf hiding in the library, and removes a tracker from Ulf.
timeline.quote: Standing over the body of the student was a grizzled man.

timeline.summary: The man kills five Phyrexian sleeper agents waiting outside the library with flame.
timeline.quote: "Yes, let's," said a deep voice behind them.

timeline.summary: Squee sends Bulp through a secret tunnel to warn a town that the Phyrexians are back and burns Rarp's body.
timeline.quote: "No, Bulp. You gotta tell them that the Phyrexians are back."

timeline.summary: Teferi brings Karn a captured Phyrexian saboteur that was in the food stores; Karn burns it in a crucible.
timeline.quote: It's the second saboteur I've found.

timeline.summary: A klaxon sounds as a vast Phyrexian army rises from the desert and begins to climb the Mana Rig.
timeline.quote: The first wave of Phyrexians scaled the Mana Rig's sides.

timeline.summary: Jhoira's cannons fire twice and bring down a Phyrexian dreadnought.
timeline.quote: It collapsed onto its own troops, crushing them.

timeline.summary: Karn sees that the Weatherlight has been compleated and is dropping Phyrexian horrors onto the deck.
timeline.quote: The Phyrexians had compleated the Weatherlight .

timeline.summary: Sheoldred rams the Mana Rig and her army swarms up her body onto the upper deck.
timeline.quote: slammed her chest into the Mana Rig's bow section like a battering ram.

timeline.summary: Jhoira wakes the Mana Rig, which stands and tears free, strides across the desert and floods the Phyrexians with lava.
timeline.quote: The Mana Rig was free.

timeline.summary: Sheoldred slams into the Mana Rig again, splits from her host body, reveals a stolen face and tells Karn the next step in evolution will be compleated.
timeline.quote: The next step in evolution will be compleated.

timeline.summary: Kaya suspects the Phyrexians have repurposed the World Tree of Kaldheim, which could join every plane.
timeline.quote: This is the World Tree of Kaldheim.

timeline.summary: A Phyrexian attack begins at night; Elspeth finds Saheeli and Kaya straining to keep the Anchor running for Teferi.
timeline.quote: The Phyrexian attack came in the dead of night.

timeline.summary: A Phyrexian skyship overpowers the watchtowers, and Elspeth orders Wrenn and Nissa to protect Teferi.
timeline.quote: Wrenn and Nissa, protect Teferi at all costs.

timeline.summary: Jodah unveils a staked trench and fire to impale the Phyrexian vanguard, and Elspeth and Jodah charge with powerstone lances that unleash scything bands of energy.
timeline.quote: Jodah unwove the phantasmal terrain spell he'd cast the previous day

timeline.summary: Elspeth fights through the horde with her sword and Halo, then orders the mechanical legion to charge.
timeline.quote: Upon hearing the command word, the metal legion defending the keep turned into aggressors

timeline.summary: The skyship unfolds into a giant legged behemoth heading for the tower.
timeline.quote: Several more gargantuan legs sprouted from the bottom of the skyship's hull

timeline.summary: At night Nissa, Wrenn and construct guardians hold the tower hall against Phyrexians who cross the threshold.
timeline.quote: Over two dozen Phyrexians had met with similar fates in the tower hall

timeline.summary: A second army of white-armored Phyrexians led by a flying winged general advances from the east.
timeline.quote: Out of the haze emerged a battalion of knights, more than a hundred strong

timeline.summary: The constructs and Phyrexians clash, and the Phyrexians fight with unusual tactics, pinning the machines.
timeline.quote: The armies collided with sharp staccato thunderclaps.

timeline.summary: Nissa and the general fall, Seven catches her, but she is dragged down by Phyrexians and reaches into the ground for the Worldsoul, Gaea.
timeline.quote: Help! Help us! she called out

timeline.summary: Gaea's will transmutes fallen constructs and Phyrexians into heartwood warriors that pour onto the battlefield and push back the Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: Gaea's would-be destroyers now reassembled themselves

timeline.summary: Urza is remade as a planeswalker as Teferi explains the Phyrexians' return and asks about activating the sylex.
timeline.quote: Urza was being remade. Stitched together into something else.

timeline.summary: Elspeth wakes alone on New Phyrexia and fights off six Phyrexians until Kaya joins her.
timeline.quote: a purple-tinged blade thrust through a Phyrexian heart

timeline.summary: Koth, Nahiri, Elspeth, Kaito and Tyvar fight the Phyrexians in the coliseum while Jace crosses unseen to Vraska.
timeline.quote: The remaining Phyrexians never stood a chance against her

timeline.summary: Outside the coliseum, the group is cornered by massed Phyrexian ranks.
timeline.quote: They stepped straight into the middle of a war.

timeline.summary: Atraxa appears fighting Phyrexian invaders above the Fair Basilica.
timeline.quote: the gleaming, wide-winged form of Atraxa

timeline.summary: Phyrexians break through the cave ceiling, invading Tidehollow.
timeline.quote: Bone-white metal. The Phyrexians had arrived.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret travels across planes already overrun by Phyrexians, finding Baltrice's safehouses compromised.
timeline.quote: Elesh Norn's "great work" was unfolding faster than Tezzeret could have imagined.

timeline.summary: Phyrexian forces rain onto Theros, devouring livestock and humans.
timeline.quote: It starts the same as it did on Kamigawa

timeline.summary: The portals open and the invasion spines descend onto Kaladesh.
timeline.quote: the great spines of invasion descended from the holes they tore in reality

timeline.summary: Saheeli's Operation Golden Scales deploys bronze lizards that clash with Phyrexian soldiers, and she rescues Pia.
timeline.quote: Deployment chambers spring up from hatches all along the street

timeline.summary: Atraxa begins scouring New Capenna, destroying its inhabitants with swarms and gas.
timeline.quote: A single thought from Atraxa summons swarms of flying servitors.

timeline.summary: Phyrexian cats attack Jirina's Coppercoats and Jirina kills one with her sword.
timeline.quote: almost severing the head entirely

timeline.summary: Chandra lands hard on the tree and Wrenn prepares to bond while centurions form around them.
timeline.quote: Plates along the tree shift and reform.

timeline.summary: Centurions speak with one woman's voice and spears pin Chandra to the tree while Phyrexian Nissa attacks Wrenn.
timeline.quote: Green magic crackles around her metallic body, her four arms all acting as conduits.

timeline.summary: A branch of Realmbreaker splits the sky over the Sun Coast and Phyrexians invade Ixalan.
timeline.quote: revealing a hideous, colossal metal branch of Realmbreaker, the Invasion Tree

timeline.summary: The Phyrexians end the emperor's war and the Threefold Sun does not rise again.
timeline.quote: The Phyrexians came to Ixalan and ended the emperor's war in its cradle.

timeline.summary: A flood of Phyrexians climbs the temple's steps toward the line.
timeline.quote: In ones and twos, they started up the lowest steps of the temple

timeline.summary: Tetzimoc, Ghalta and Nezahal answer Huatli's call and tear through the Phyrexians in the streets.
timeline.quote: Nezahal wrapped the giant up from legs to wrists

timeline.summary: Zacama, the last and greatest elder, arrives and her roar disintegrates the Phyrexian front ranks.
timeline.quote: Zacama, the final and greatest of the elders, loomed up from the shadows

timeline.summary: A Phyrexian dog attacks Rankle and Torbran kills it with his axe.
timeline.quote: he opened his eyes and saw the beast in two halves and a red-bearded dwarf yanking his axe out of the carnage

timeline.summary: Rankle and Torbran see Locthwain crashed to the ground, its knights and the queen transformed by Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: To Rankle's shock, she was not herself.

timeline.summary: Rankle hands over the ring but wishes the love potion to rain down, and a chasm opens as the pink rain falls on the horde.
timeline.quote: Instantly, the skies opened, and drops of pink rain began to fall.

timeline.summary: Lovestruck by the rain, the Phyrexian legions chase Rankle and pour over the edge into the chasm.
timeline.quote: Wave after wave followed him, pouring over the edge like lovestruck lemmings.

timeline.summary: A spell of many voices puts everyone in the chasm to sleep, and Rankle drifts down onto a throne of his fallen admirers.
timeline.quote: Rankle could see that everyone in the chasm had fallen into an unnatural sleep.

timeline.summary: Bored at the Engelturm, Gisa watches Phyrexians shamble out of the Silburlind River.
timeline.quote: A small group of bipedal figures shambled out of the Silburlind River

timeline.summary: A Phyrexian cuts one of Gisa's ghouls in two with an oil-slick sword, and Gisa sends her dead to attack them.
timeline.quote: All around her, the dead she had risen for her own amusement turned toward the cluster on the shore.

timeline.summary: Gisa's ghouls destroy the group, but a Phyrexian corpse she raises collapses lifeless the moment her attention wanders; this has never happened to her before.
timeline.quote: This had never happened to her before.

timeline.summary: Geralf warns Gisa not to touch the oil and reveals the invaders are Phyrexians, which Ludevic learned of after a fight with a strange white-haired visitor.
timeline.quote: DO NOT LET THE OIL TOUCH YOU!

timeline.summary: Geralf explains the Phyrexians seek to turn Innistrad into an outpost of their empire, and that their oil cannot infect risen dead.
timeline.quote: They wish to transform our glorious home into one more outpost along their long road to empire.

timeline.summary: Geralf sends his grotesque creations, including exploding winged turtles, to meet the Phyrexians between the river and the city.
timeline.quote: A wave of terrible creations swarmed over the walls of Havengul to meet the Phyrexians between the river and the city.

timeline.summary: A Phyrexian moondrake rises, and Gisa's moondrake kills it in the air and on the ground, spoiling a Phyrexian plan.
timeline.quote: her drake ripped the other's head clean off

timeline.summary: A second Phyrexian force approaches overland past the Engelturm, and Gisa complains it is cheating.
timeline.quote: "I said three-way, not four-way,"

timeline.summary: Geralf's antlered behemoth steps over the city wall and tramples Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: A towering beast stepped over the Havengul wall

timeline.summary: Not to be outdone, Gisa sings up a colossal chitinous beast from the bottom of the estuary, and it wades into the Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: Gisa's terrible new plaything rose from the bottom of the estuary

timeline.summary: The Phyrexians hack off the legs of Geralf's behemoth and then Gisa's sea-beast; both fall and Gisa stops laughing.
timeline.quote: Like the behemoth before it, it fell

timeline.summary: The fusion of behemoth and sea-beast rises and, with Gisa's ghouls, destroys the remaining attacking Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: watching the last of the attacking forces as they fell, screaming, before the tide of the dead.

timeline.summary: Elspeth is shown the Phyrexian assault on New Capenna led by the corrupted angel Atraxa.
timeline.quote: "They call her Atraxa."

timeline.summary: Elspeth finds she cannot affect events as an observer, even as Phyrexian beasts slaughter citizens.
timeline.quote: She tries to save the man only for her hands to fade through him.

timeline.summary: Phyrexian ranks falter and Koth, healed, calls magma and rallies the Mirrans.
timeline.quote: "Mirrodin!" says Koth. "With me!"

timeline.summary: Melira is struck down by Phyrexian spears on the bridge as Koth screams.
timeline.quote: That person crumpling to the ground—is that Melira?

timeline.summary: Wrenn grows a massive portal as Elspeth is flung through the gate by a war engine, and the Phyrexian army pours through into Zhalfir's peaceful land.
timeline.quote: The monstrosity flings the angel through the gate

timeline.summary: Vraska narrates being compleated: her throat and tendrils turn to metal, she petrifies Phyrexian agents until she is overwhelmed, and her self retreats into a hidden corner of her mind.
timeline.quote: I writhed and arched my back as Phyrexian oil rushed past my teeth.

timeline.summary: Vraska's forces land at the prison where she was held, triggering a memory of her imprisonment at seventeen.
timeline.quote: It is the prison I was held in, the prison I tried, and succeeded, in escaping

timeline.summary: Vraska has Phyrexian agents blind the Azorius and Boros guards, and orders the blinded forced to the Transguild Promenade as an example.
timeline.quote: "Lead them to the Transguild Promenade as an example of what we do to the unjust."

timeline.summary: Vraska leads the Phyrexians into the Golgari undercity, transforming her people into Phyrexians while Realmbreaker upends Korozda and cracks Svogthos.
timeline.quote: It is a hive in the truest sense, all pieces of a single purpose.

timeline.summary: Vraska's forces transform her subjects and defeat Selesnyan warriors in the undercity.
timeline.quote: a cohort of Selesnyan warriors tear through a hole in the maze

timeline.summary: Vraska orders her compleated Golgari to spill oil and blind the populace, leaving citizens collapsed in terror in the streets.
timeline.quote: "Spill as much glistening oil on the streets as you can,"

timeline.summary: Vraska's forces destroy the roof of the Chamber of the Guildpact and Niv-Mizzet's seat.
timeline.quote: delighting in crushing Niv-Mizzet's seat

timeline.summary: Vraska collapses, her broken body is deserted by her forces, and Ral walks away apologizing.
timeline.quote: My forces do not stay long enough for me to argue my case

timeline.summary: Nahiri, compleated and with blades for hands, surveys the Phyrexian invasion from a floating stone and decides to use the Emeria Skyclave to connect the hedron networks.
timeline.quote: the Skyclave in Emeria will be the perfect access point to connect the entire hedron networks

timeline.summary: Tazri commands Sea Gate's defenders against waves of Phyrexians from the Invasion Tree's branches.
timeline.quote: "This is our home! We've killed false gods for it! No invader will ever claim it from us!"

timeline.summary: Erem is speared, dragged into a seedpod and transformed, laughing mechanically, as Tazri fails to save him.
timeline.quote: two invaders drag him into the nearest seedpod and seal him within.

timeline.summary: Linvala carries Tazri away as Sea Gate falls to the Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: From above, Tazri watches in horror as her home is, again, consumed by creatures not from this plane.

timeline.summary: Akiri tracks Nahiri, watching the Skyclave turn to white metal and more invaders arrive.
timeline.quote: She's witnessed the Skyclave's broken stone mend and transform into white metal.

timeline.summary: On Kaladesh, Pia Nalaar braces for death on a platform when the Phyrexians suddenly crumble and she thanks Chandra.
timeline.quote: All over Ghirapur it is the same: the Phyrexians are falling.

timeline.summary: Atraxa, a corrupted angel, cuts through New Capenna's defenses while the angels, demons and devils fight her armies.
timeline.quote: She cuts her way through the city's defenses as a farmer threshing wheat.

timeline.summary: On the way they pass Phyrexian remnants and Ruby throws an apple at a laughing pixie.
timeline.quote: Ruby picks up an apple from her basket and flings it hard as a giant flinging a boulder

timeline.summary: Izoni says the Swarm hides because of something not of Ravnica, and Proft fears the invaders have changed tactics.
timeline.quote: We may not have won as decisively as we all want to believe.

timeline.summary: Proft says the flower is not Phyrexian and that his announced interviews were a ruse to bait the killer.
timeline.quote: This flower is not Phyrexian in origin.

timeline.summary: The Phyrexian invasion destroys the plane's power balance and nearly decimates the Lorwyn elves, whose networks of power are turned to Phyrexian use.
timeline.quote: The Phyrexian invasion destroyed the fragile power balance of the plane

timeline.summary: Shadowmoor boggarts form the vanguard against the invaders, riding cavalry into enemy lines at great cost.
timeline.quote: The boggarts formed the vanguard, riding their cavalry into the enemy lines and gutting them from within.

timeline.summary: Shadowmoor kithkin lead the last charge that destroys the Phyrexian invaders, then shut themselves in their homes.
timeline.quote: it was the isolationist Shadowmoor kithkin that led the last charge to destroy the invaders.

timeline.summary: The Hound of Bristlebane skewers a Dominus with a spear along a branch of the Invasion Tree.
timeline.quote: singlehandedly drove a spear through the body of a Dominus, skewering it from neck to knee

timeline.summary: Lorwyn merrow flee into the deepest parts of the Wanderwine when the Phyrexians attack the water.
timeline.quote: Many were forced to flee into the deepest parts of the Wanderwine.

timeline.summary: Shadowmoor merrow escape to the Dark Meanders to wait out the invasion and adapt to their new environment.
timeline.quote: they escaped to the Dark Meanders, tunnels deep under the plane, hoping to wait out the invasion beneath the water.

timeline.summary: Elvish authority in Lorwyn collapses as the invasion destroys the infrastructure of the power imbalance, letting other species reclaim sovereignty.
timeline.quote: This vacuum allowed the other species on the plane to gain ground, clawing back ancestral lands and reclaiming sovereignty.

timeline.summary: As a child, Elspeth's plane is invaded by the Phyrexians and she is taken captive.
timeline.quote: As a child, her plane was invaded by the horrifying Phyrexians.

relations.note: Karn wants to destroy them forever with the Sylex
relations.quote: I need to take it to New Phyrexia and destroy their plane once and for all.

relations.note: Regent and Mother of Machines who rules the Machine Orthodoxy.
relations.quote: Elesh Norn, Phyrexian regent and Mother of Machines

relations.note: Acolytes work for the Phyrexians.
relations.quote: Acolytes in the gray robes of the Society of Mishra attended surgical machines

relations.note: Karn is determined to stop them.
relations.quote: eradicate the Phyrexian threat at its source

relations.note: A kor Phyrexian leader.
relations.quote: "Phyrexia is the greatest of freedoms."

relations.note: The ship has been corrupted into a Phyrexian monstrosity.
relations.quote: said the Weatherlight she knew was dead

relations.note: Urza will spend his life fighting the Phyrexians.
relations.quote: You're going to spend your life trying to fight the Phyrexians.

relations.note: Phyrexians trapped the surviving Mirrans beneath the shell
relations.quote: trapping those of us who'd survived to keep fighting underneath

relations.note: fights them as her infection spreads
relations.quote: The remaining Phyrexians never stood a chance against her

relations.note: have compleated some of the Maestros, who now serve the invasion
relations.quote: Maestros, they call themselves.

relations.note: ended the emperor's war and ring the capital
relations.quote: A ring of white stones surrounded Pachatupa

relations.note: Torbran fights the invaders and lays a trap for them
relations.quote: We have laid a trap for these monsters.

relations.note: Transformed Ayara commands the Phyrexian troops in a harsh language
relations.quote: as she marshaled her troops in a harsh, unfamiliar language

relations.note: Gisa's ghouls fight them
relations.quote: fought brilliantly and hard, but in the end, they were outnumbered by a factor of dozens.

relations.note: Geralf defends Havengul against them
relations.quote: he has elected to trust me with the defense of Havengul

relations.note: Atraxa is one of their fanatical generals
relations.quote: One of their most fanatical generals.

relations.note: Norn is the Grand Praetor whose will is Phyrexia's
relations.quote: Our will is Phyrexia's will.

relations.note: Anhelo has been converted and tries to bring Errant over
relations.quote: Come, I can show you the beauty of New Phyrexia.

relations.note: Atraxa leads the conversion of New Capenna
relations.quote: The head Phyrexian had been content to ignore them so far.

relations.note: Nahiri aids the Phyrexian conquest of Zendikar
relations.quote: Far below her, the Phyrexian invasion is gaining ground.

relations.note: Her connection to the Phyrexians still haunts her
relations.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
relations.quote: part of her misses hearing those planes.

relations.note: The king died defending his family against the invasion
relations.quote: But the good king is dead—slain defending his family to the last

relations.note: hero of the war against them
relations.quote: hero of the war against the Phyrexians

relations.note: lost much in the war against them
relations.quote: all she'd lost in the war against the Phyrexians

relations.note: Phyrexians infected kithkin and exploited the thoughtweft.
relations.quote: infecting kithkin and using the thoughtweft to poison their comrades' minds

relations.note: They invaded her plane and took her captive.
relations.quote: Taken captive, she escaped when her Spark ignited

The invaders who destroyed a whole plane and whom Karn wants to destroy with the Sylex.
The enemies Karn believes are still a threat.
Threat of flesh, metal and black oil that Teferi warns Arlinn about.
Invaders whose past incursion on New Capenna is hinted at by the statues of an angel fighting a spined creature.
A monstrous threat Elspeth sees in the museum's artwork and aims to stop.
An invading force that once attacked Capenna and is now a threat to everyone.

The invaders who have infiltrated Dominaria's governments and infested the watchtower.
Patchwork, artificial soldiers who gather at the Vess estate to find the ring.
The invaders who hold a cave base, a dreadnought and a dragon engine.
Sleeper agents who have infiltrated the academy and murder Ulf's roommates and others.
The invaders who infiltrate Squee's clan.
The feared invaders, whose supposed sleeper agents drive Femeref's prejudice.
The invaders whose war construct tore open the dragon's hoardgrave.
The compleated invaders under Sheoldred and Elesh Norn who attack the Mana Rig.

The compleated horde invading every plane.
The compleated horde besieging Strixhaven.
The compleated horde invading Ikoria.
The compleated horde of New Phyrexia.
